observations: Photo 0 shows a full-size electric sewing machine on a table/stand.
Brand/model text appears on the machine body/faceplate but is not clearly readable in the provided image.
There is a foot pedal and power cord visible on the table.
No close-up of the needle area, bobbin case, stitch selector, or any working indicators.
No photo of accessories (presser feet, spare needles, manual) or of the machine running.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show the machine running or any test stitch output.
This is seller intent/behavior, not verifiable from the photo.

risks.risk: Whether it truly works (motor speed, timing, and stitch formation) is not proven by the photos.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine sewing a straight line and a zigzag on fabric, showing the needle moving continuously and the thread tension looking correct.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/possibly needing service (use the lower end of the comparable range).

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model and whether it is manual vs electric, and whether it is a basic home machine or higher-spec unit.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the brand/model plate and the stitch/feature labels (photo of the faceplate and any sticker with model number).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic electric home sewing machine (not industrial), at the lower end.

risks.risk: Missing/uncertain accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power adapter/cord condition) can reduce value.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out (presser feet set, bobbins, needles, manual if any) plus a close-up of the bobbin/bobbin case area.

risks.risk: Potential mechanical issues not visible (belt wear, motor noise, thread tension problems, bent needle, worn feed dogs).
risks.proof: Video showing feed dogs moving under load and a close-up of thread tension while sewing; also a photo of the needle and feed dog condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may need minor repair/adjustment (lower end).

proof_requests: Send a 30–60 second video sewing on fabric (straight stitch + zigzag) with the pedal pressed, showing consistent stitching.
Send a clear close-up of the brand/model plate (faceplate/sticker) so the exact model can be identified.
Send photos of included accessories: presser feet, bobbins, needles, and any manual.
Send a close-up of the bobbin case area and needle/needle clamp.
response.reason: The item type is visible (electric sewing machine on a stand), but the key claim that it works perfectly is not proven by the single photo, and the brand/model is not readable enough to confidently price beyond worst-case assumptions.
